actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.call.VoicemailServices.get#VoicemailSettings').requireNewTransaction(true).disableAuthz().call() || {} const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() const caps = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.call.VoiceServices.get#VoiceCapabilities').requireNewTransaction(true).disableAuthz().call() || {} ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({errors, box: out.box || null, myNumberList: out.myNumberList || [], accessNumberList: out.accessNumberList || [], ringSeconds: out.ringSeconds || 45, ringSecondsEach: out.ringSecondsEach || 6, maxRings: out.maxRings || 10, maxSeconds: out.maxSeconds || 120, transcribeOn: !!out.transcribeOn, pinMinDigits: out.pinMinDigits || 6, phoneActive: !!caps.active, phoneSupported: !!caps.supported})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.call.VoicemailServices.delete#VoicemailGreeting').requireNewTransaction(true).disableAuthz().call() || {} const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({errors, box: out.box || null})
